notes.title: Town of Machine Update 1.12 now live!
notes.content:
This update provides a number of quality of life updates and fixes. Enjoy :)

- Weapon Kits now carry over to NG+ and beyond
- Increased upgraded SMG damage
- Fixed SMG Upgrade Achievement
- Fixed melee sometimes not hitting enemy
- Fixed some line of sight issues
- Fixed area of effect damage sometimes not hitting enemies correctly
- Rebalanced damage of some area of effect weapons to compensate for the much more accurate hit detection
- Fixed enemies occasionally still attacking even if being stunned or dead

notes.title: New Game Plus Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39928794/90feb19f72683f58e9ef43d8be43eeb33efb8ca8.png[/img]
This new content update adds two new modes to the game: New Game Plus and New Game Plus Plus. After completing the game, additional content gets unlocked for much greater replayability. Find Black Casino Chips to buy new Weapon Upgrades for each weapon, fight different and more challenging enemy encounters throughout the entire game, find a new hidden weapon and last but not least - unleash the ultimate stopping power with the new [b]Ultra Cannon[/b]!
